unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); no '(**)' cells occur in this section. Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Full visual render and cid-decoded text-layer cross-check completed for page 19. The section's printed totals are net-negative in every period. This-Month Gross and Net roll-ups each require tol 1 under the printed rounding note. The three line-level Proprietary Applicable cells are standalone single-source values; section-total Applicable cells are covered by exact total-row net identities.
